Core

IconButton

Icon-only round button. Class contract: .rse-icon-button. Accepts every native attribute and a ref.

Live example

The example needs JavaScript; the usage below shows the markup.

Usage

Circular icon-only button for compact actions (close, share, arrows in carousels).

<IconButton ariaLabel="Fechar" icon={<XIcon/>} variant="ghost" />

Always pass ariaLabel. Use ghost on light surfaces, primary when it needs to stand out as the main action.

Props

PropTypeRequiredNotes
iconReact.ReactNodeyes
ariaLabelstring—Accessible label for the icon-only button (required — there is no visible text). Also accepts the native aria-label.
aria-labelstring—
variantprimary ghost—
sizesm md lg—
typebutton submit reset—

Also accepts every attribute of Omit<React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'type'>, a ref and className.
